content: संप्रयोगः .²1 Union, connection; meeting, conjunction, contact; (जलस्य) उष्णत्वमग्न्यातपसंप्रयोगात् <ls>R. 5. 54</ls>; <ls>M. 5. 3</ls>. .²2 A connecting link, fastening; एतेन मोचयति भूषणसंप्रयोगान् <ls>Mk. 3. 16</ls>. .²3 Relation, dependence. .²4 Mutual relation or proportion. .²5 Connected series or order. .²6 Sexual union, coition; स्त्रीपुंसयोः संप्रयोगे स्पर्शः कस्याधिको भवेत् <ls>Mb. 13. 12. 1</ls>. .²7 Application. .²8 Magic. .²9 Mutual intercourse; संप्रयोगो भवेन्नायं मम मोघस्त्वया द्विज <ls>Mb. 1. 47. 39</ls>. .²10 Co-operation; लब्धा महीं ब्राह्मणसंप्रयोगात् <ls>Mb. 3. 26. 13</ls>. .²11 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) Conjuction (of the moon and the lunar mansions).
